title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28.1): Enable Investment Boost for fixed assets (Bonus Depreciation Method)
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 1 introduces Investment Boost for fixed assets, allowing eligible assets to deduct a configured percentage in the acquisition year while depreciating the remaining balance through standard methods. This feature reduces first-year tax burden and streamlines compliance with front-loaded investment incentive schemes like New Zealand's rules.
key_points: Investment Boost lets companies deduct a set percentage (e.g., 20-60%) of an asset's cost in the purchase year, then depreciate the remainder normally
Administrators configure the bonus depreciation percentage and effective date in Fixed Asset Setup
Individual assets can be marked with 'Use Bonus Depreciation' flag in the depreciation book to enable the incentive
System maintains a clear audit trail by posting the boost deduction and adjusted depreciation as separate entries
Validation prevents double-application and ensures the asset's availability date meets the effective-date rule

quotes.text: Validation ensures the Date Available for Use meets the effective-date rule and prevents double-application.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the system's safeguards to maintain audit integrity and prevent calculation errors
